interface.title: Time-lapse movie condenser
interface.field: Cell biology / neuroscience fluorescence imaging (calcium signalling, propagating calcium waves)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and figure-making: turning a recorded time-lapse fluorescence movie into checked numbers and a figure ready for print
interface.what_it_is_for: Condense a calcium-imaging movie into one temporal colour-code image plus a multi-panel publication figure, and estimate wave speed and direction with stated reliability (planarity R2, flow coherence, kymograph cross-check), while letting the user check the detected wave axis and ROIs against a std-projection overlay.

data.note: Used the 'Demo (synthetic wave)' source: 120 frames, 160 x 200 px, which loaded at once. Selecting 'Upload movie' shows a TIFF/MP4/AVI/MOV uploader (200 MB limit), but browser_list_files returned no test files, so no real movie was loaded. Default calibration is 0.5 s/frame and 0.65 um/px. The demo recovered 2.103–2.111 px/frame (planar estimator) and 2.115–2.180 px/frame (kymograph cross-check), close to but a little below the ~2.2 px/frame named in the notes.

tree.general: Summarise a fluorescence time-lapse into one image and trustworthy numbers for a propagating signal, then export figures ready for print
tree.specific: Condense a calcium-imaging movie into a temporal colour code, check the wave axis and ROI outlines, estimate calcium-wave speed with planarity R2 and flow coherence, and download the 300 dpi one-image summary and full figure

features.name: Temporal colour-code map with selectable timing definition and colour scale
features.general: Collapse a time series of images into one image whose colour shows when each pixel was active and whose brightness shows how strongly; choose how 'when' is computed, the colour scale and the display brightness curve; read absolute time off a colourbar
features.specific: One-image summary (temporal color code) driven by Time-encoding (peak/com), Colormap (hsv/cividis/viridis/plasma) and Brightness gamma (display only); Spatial denoise (px) also changes it, but as smoothing before dF/F that feeds the timing and speed too; colourbar 'time of peak (s)' and um scale bar follow the calibration
steps: Pick Time-encoding peak or com
Pick a Colormap
Optionally raise Spatial denoise to smooth noisy pixels before timing (this also changes coherence and speed)
Lower Brightness gamma to lift dim but real signal in the display
Read activation timing off the colourbar and download the 300 dpi PNG
serves_tasks: View a map that colour-codes the time each pixel was active
Choose how activation time is defined
Choose a colour scale for the time map
Smooth the recording spatially before activation times are computed
Adjust the display brightness curve to bring out weak activity

features.name: Propagation-speed readout with reliability gate
features.general: Estimate how fast a front travels from an activation-time map, report fit quality (planarity, coherence) plus an independent cross-check, and decline to report a number when coherence falls below a user-set threshold
features.specific: Recovered numbers: planar-estimator wave speed (px/frame and um/s), planarity R2, flow coherence, kymograph-ridge cross-check; the Wave-coherence gate slider switches to 'No coherent wave detected… No speed is reported' and removes the speed from the kymograph title
steps: Read speed, R2, flow coherence and cross-check (2.103 px/frame, R2 0.996, coherence 0.933 at defaults)
Raise Wave-coherence gate to require a stricter wave
See the speed withheld once the gate exceeds the measured coherence (0.90 kept, 0.95 withheld; coherence was 0.918 with denoise 2 and gamma 0.3 in the run, 0.933 at defaults)
Lower the gate to get the provisional number back
serves_tasks: Read the propagation speed with its reliability scores
Refuse to report a speed when the signal is not a coherent wave

features.name: Detection-check overlay (axis + ROI outlines on std projection)
features.general: Overlay automatically detected regions and the analysis direction on a variability image so a person can confirm or reject the detections, then change preprocessing and re-check
features.specific: Verification: std projection with the dashed kymograph axis and white detected-ROI outlines next to 'Detected ROIs: n'; changing Photobleach correction or F0 baseline percentile re-segments (3 vs 5 ROIs)
steps: Look at the std projection and count the white outlines against the visible bright cells
Toggle Photobleach correction or move F0 baseline percentile
Re-check the outlines and Detected ROIs count
Open fullscreen for a closer look
serves_tasks: Compare the detected direction and regions against an activity image
Fix missed detections by changing preprocessing and re-checking

features.name: Analysis line: automatic or typed endpoints feeding a kymograph
features.general: Define the line along which a space-time profile is sampled, either fitted automatically or typed as two endpoints, and see the line overlaid and the derived speed update
features.specific: 4. Kymograph axis: 'Auto axis (PCA of active region)' checkbox; when unticked, x0/y0/x1/y1 fields set the dashed axis, which redraws on the verification image and changes the kymograph-ridge cross-check (2.116 auto, 2.180 horizontal (10,80)-(190,80), 2.119 diagonal (10,120)-(190,40))
steps: Untick Auto axis
Type x0, y0, x1, y1
Check the dashed line on the verification overlay
Read the new kymograph-ridge cross-check and Kymograph panel
Re-tick Auto axis to return to the PCA axis
serves_tasks: Cross-check speed along a user-defined line
Read the space-time plot of the signal along the wave axis

features.name: Region traces sorted by onset (heatmap + traces)
features.general: Show each detected region's normalised signal over time as heatmap rows ordered by onset, next to stacked line traces, so the order of recruitment can be read off
features.specific: Panel D of the full figure: 'Per-ROI dF/F (n = 5)' heatmap with rows 'sorted by onset' and 'Representative ROI traces' (dF/F offset); the dF/F scale responds to F0 baseline percentile (~4.5 at 10, ~2.8 at 50)
steps: Scroll to panel D
Read rows top to bottom as the recruitment order
Change F0 baseline percentile and compare the dF/F scale
serves_tasks: Read regional activity traces ordered by when each region turned on

features.name: Composite figure for publication with high-resolution export
features.general: Assemble a fixed multi-panel figure (snapshots over time, time map, space-time plot, region traces, variability and max projections) that tracks all current settings, view it fullscreen, and download it at print resolution
features.specific: Full publication figure panels A–E (Movie summary frames, Temporal color code, Kymograph with speed, Per-ROI dF/F, Std-dev and Max projection), Fullscreen button, 'Download full figure (300 dpi PNG)' -> movie_summary.png
steps: Tune settings in the sidebar
Review the figure inline or in Fullscreen
Press Download full figure (300 dpi PNG)
serves_tasks: Read the space-time plot of the signal along the wave axis
Orient with snapshots over time and whole-recording variability and maximum images

features.name: Calibration to physical units
features.general: Enter the time between frames and the size of a pixel so speeds, time axes and scale bars come out in physical units
features.specific: 2. Calibration: Frame interval (s/frame) and Pixel size (um/px) drive the um/s speed, the colourbar time range in seconds and the um scale bar (1.0 s and 0.70 um gave 1.472 um/s and a colourbar to ~120 s)
steps: Type the Frame interval (s/frame)
Set the Pixel size (um/px)
Read the physical speed, colourbar range and scale bar
serves_tasks: Set acquisition calibration so results come out in physical units

features.name: Preprocessing before timing (photobleach correction, F0 baseline, spatial denoise)
features.general: Correct slow fading of the signal, choose the baseline used to normalise each pixel, and smooth spatially before activation times, speeds and regions are computed
features.specific: Photobleach correction checkbox, F0 baseline percentile slider (dF/F baseline) and Spatial denoise (px); together they change the time map, flow coherence and speed, the dF/F scale and the Detected ROIs count (photobleach off at F0 30 gave 3 ROIs instead of 5)
steps: Keep Photobleach correction on unless the recording has no fading
Set F0 baseline percentile for dF/F
Optionally raise Spatial denoise for noisy movies
Re-read Detected ROIs, coherence and speed after each change
serves_tasks: Fix missed detections by changing preprocessing and re-checking
Smooth the recording spatially before activation times are computed
